The story is a quiet, atmospheric slice-of-life narrative that does not contain any real plot twists, major character developments, or thematic revelations that subvert the reader's expectations "in a thrilling way." At the very end, an element of mystery is introduced when Ilse receives a phone call from someone named "Jonas" and chooses to ignore it as she heads back into the fog.
